info.title: RLC ringing and damping
info.question: How do electric and magnetic stored energy produce ringing?
info.expected: Capacitor voltage overshoots 5 V and rings while current reverses; R1 dissipates energy and the response settles.
info.try: Compare 50 Ω underdamping with 200 Ω critical damping and 500 Ω overdamping. Inspect signed L1 current and C1 voltage; startup edits reset the experiment.
info.limitation: Ideal L/C with explicit series resistance. No winding saturation, ESR, parasitic capacitance or ratings. Internal integration and output sampling have separate work/resolution limits.
